gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.
I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
You'd better ___ a taxi or you'll miss the plane.
gaps.explanation: had better takes the bare infinitive: you'd better take.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
Do you know how ___ this machine?
gaps.explanation: know how/what/where + to-infinitive: know how to operate.

gaps.sentence: He spent months ___ the application, only to be rejected in minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time doing something' takes the gerund.
